name: 17-city-night-arrival
prompt: A black car pulling up outside a discreet, unmarked townhouse door in a London street at night, wet cobbles reflecting warm amber light, a soft pink glow in the doorway. Cinematic, luxury, high-end corporate film. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, rich shadows, filmic grain. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.
